referenceFidelity.findings: The arch springline, narrow metal muntins, light projecting sill and broad stucco spandrel reproduce the researched historic warehouse vocabulary at modular scale.

construction.findings: A coherent twelve-segment extruded arch and full-depth opening replace flat painted treatment. Widened base/cornice endcaps slightly so their visible ends are not coincident with the stucco end plane; front and reverse reveal the actual aperture.

readability.findings: Single tall arched window and chunky pale trim remain recognizable on the 390 px viewport; repeated deployment gives a clear facade rhythm.

motion.findings: Deliberately static environment architecture, no skeleton or authored clips.

secondPass.findings: Inspected the current rebuilt front, rear, oblique and phone after endcap repair. The side-end band shimmer is removed, the sill has deliberate depth and the arch frame remains concentric.

userAcceptance.note: User authorized creation but has not explicitly accepted this model revision.

limitations: Original interpreted campus architecture; complete measured GitHub as-built CAD documentation was not found.
